name: pizzeria-roadrash
description: Browser/PWA LAN motorcycle racing and combat game - rainy cyberpunk night.

scripts.build: npm run build:relay && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.build:relay: esbuild src/server/relay/vercelEntry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outfile=api/relay.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build:relay from src/server/relay/vercelEntry.ts. Do not edit."
